title: Mini MURDLE — The Missing Extension
subtitle: Mini mode: 3 suspects, 3 weapons, 3 locations
storyHtml: A valuable Business Central extension vanished before its release. One Dynavics specialist used an everyday office item to hide the evidence somewhere in the App Lab.

clues.text: Ava was working in the Demo Suite, not the App Lab.
The person in the App Lab used the USB Key.
Cora was not in the Project Room.
The Tablet was found in the Project Room.
